# The model draw order (menu 288, ModelDisplayOrderDlgProc) and calculate
# order (menu 289, ModelCalculateOrderDlgProc) dialogs: list 628, up 630,
# down 631, OK 632. The draw order's OK ends in camera mode.
load model chain8.pmx
load model .\lips.pmd
load model morph4.pmx
save pmm before.pmm
model draw order open
dialog select 628 2
dialog click 630
dialog click 630
dialog click 632
save pmm draw.pmm

model calc order open
dialog select 628 0
dialog click 631
dialog click 632
save pmm calc.pmm

model calc order open
dialog select 628 2
dialog click 630
dialog cancel
save pmm calc-cancelled.pmm
